description: This file defines the OA_PermanentCache class, which manages reading, saving, and removing cached data with features like serialization, compression, and cache ID/group generation.

classes.name: OA_PermanentCache
classes.description: A class for handling persistent cache storage, including serialization, compression, and cache ID/group management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specified or default cache path and configures the Cache_Lite object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cache content by cache name, decompresses and unserializes it if found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and compresses data, then saves it to cache if the cache path is writable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entry by cache name.

methods.name: _getId
methods.description: Generates a cache ID based on the cache name, handling class::method notation and stripping extensions.

methods.name: _getGroup
methods.description: Generates a cache group name based on the cache name and path, defaulting to 'default'.
